question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

It is believed that God is ________.
solution:
The correct answer is **option (3)** i.e.** ‘omnipresent’.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The sentence talks about God and the beliefs of people regarding God.
 
• **Omnipresent:** (सर्वव्यापी) present everywhere simultaneously, or seemingly everywhere at the same time.
 
 
• **Example: **In the digital age, social media has become nearly omnipresent, connecting people from different corners of the world.
 
 
 
• The other options do not make any sense in this context.
 
• Hence,** ‘omnipresent’** is the most appropriate to fill in the blank.

Therefore, the correct answer is ‘omnipresent’. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• **Pacifist: **(शांतिवादी) a person who believes in or advocates for peace and opposes violence or war.

 
 
• **Example:** Many pacifists actively work toward global disarmament and peaceful conflict resolution.
 
 
 
• **Optimist:** (आशावादी) a person who generally has a positive outlook on life and expects good outcomes. 
 
 
• **Example: **Despite facing adversity, she is an optimist who always sees the positive sides.
 
 
 
• **Omnivorous: **(सर्वाहारी) eating or consuming both animal and plant-based food.
 
 
• **Example:** Bears are omnivorous creatures.
 
 
 
• **‘Omni’** is a root word- It means of all things; in all ways or places.
